subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: The Lathe: Mother of Machine Tools
description: A quick win: understand The Lathe: Mother of Machine Tools.

hook.text: The lathe is called the mother of all machine tools. Every shop has one.

buildup.text: It spins a workpiece while a cutting tool shaves it into a round shape.

discovery.text: A lathe can cut threads, bore holes, and turn complex profiles.

twist.text: Maudslay's screw-cutting lathe in 1800 enabled precise, repeatable threads.

climax.text: Without the lathe, no accurate shafts, screws, or cylinders would exist.

punchline.text: Spin it and cut it — the lathe shapes the tools that shape everything.

quiz.question: Why is the lathe called the 'mother of machine tools'?
options: It was the first machine tool ever invented
It makes the round parts needed to build all other machine tools
It is the largest and most expensive machine in any shop
